title: Chess... but it's Battle Royale
summary: Chess Arena (chessarena.gg playtest): real-time 40-player battle royale with chess pieces on a big 3D map. Each player is a king who summons an army, clears guardian pits for XP, acquires queen shrines, and survives the shrinking purple poison zone; capturing a king is checkmate and destroys that army. He picks champions (Eldrin/Blizzard, later 'Lore') and eventually gets a first victory.
rules: Real-time: no turns; each piece has its own cooldown bar after moving; you can move several pieces at once by dragging. Pieces keep their normal chess movement patterns.
Press Q to summon an army (cooldown) ; capture by moving into a piece.
Capturing a king = checkmate: destroys that player's whole army and eliminates them. Losing other pieces is fine.

Guardian pits (differently coloured square groups): capture all guardians to clear the pit for rewards; collect XP orbs (stand next to them) to level up; wait near a Queen Shrine to acquire it and summon a queen.
Battle royale: 40 players (plus bots); the map shrinks via purple poison; last king standing wins. Bushes reduce vision.
Champion select (~28 s) before the match: champions have abilities, e.g. Blizzard: slows enemies, ice shield that protects from death once, stuns.
win_condition: Be the last king standing (top placement), checkmating others along the way.
